U.note: Readable pelican with big pouch, helmet and wing on the handlebar, working pause, speed, reverse and honk controls, though the legs and hip placement are a bit odd.

V.note: Most polished in craft, controls and accessibility, but it swaps in a cargo bike with a crate and the S-curved neck and wing are not on the handlebar.

W.note: Clean and correct pelican on a regular bike with pause, speed and honk, but the legs and pedals look slightly tangled.

X.note: Large, well-drawn bike and pelican with a nice pouch and chain details, a hand-on-bar wing, and pause, cadence and click-to-honk controls.

Y.note: Layered parallax hills, a bell and a speed readout, but the pelican's neck is faint and the legs and frame are thin.

Z.note: Cute outlined pelican with a clear neck and bill that reads well, a simple bike and few controls (pause, speed).
